purpose: Single-pole causal lesson, not robot deployment or a new tuning framework

noiseInjectionForMatchedCases.scope: Test-fixture authority only. Not read by the R estimator; held constant across arms and boundary mechanisms.

evaluation.scope: No pass threshold forces a performance improvement; fail/rejection and equal-prefix/full-duration metrics remain separate.

notes: Written before this lesson's paired runs; no optimization against this case set.
Stationary sample covariance estimates repeatability around an unknown constant, not absolute bias, Q_e, time delay or dynamic calibration.
Physical plant, controller gain, Q_e, initial conditions, samples and limits are unchanged across arms; only assumed R_e differs.
Same random seed is not identical measured data after controllers produce different trajectories. A separate same-data observer replay is included.
NIS is diagnostic under these nonlinear/model/noise assumptions, not a chi-square certification. Hardware and general-N claims are excluded.
